title: Close guard accepts a [WARGAMING] record that says nothing was attacked, or one written by hand
description: Found by the TASK-240 wargaming pass (rounds 16-17, MEDIUM). checkWargamingRecord / hasValidWargamingComment / the delivery-body block 3 only test for a CU<n> keyword plus a path word. So (a) a record that openly says "Wrecker not connected, nothing was attacked, CU1..CU9 and their paths pending" satisfies the guard and the ticket closes as verified, and (b) a hand-written Wrecker-looking record with no --wrecker-record run behind it also closes. (a) is the negation gap already named in src/task-store.js around line 1636 (ruled out of scope by TASK-234/WG2-M-03); TASK-240's CU5 ("does not close as verified") therefore rests on procedure only. Replayable probe: TASK-240 wargaming scratchpad wargame-240/probes/b5-procedure.mjs (copy it into the test as the fixture).
acceptance_criteria: Replaying the TASK-240 round-17 inputs (a [WARGAMING] comment or a closing block 3 that states nothing was attacked) no longer lets the ticket close.
A genuine wargaming record (default engine or Wrecker) still closes exactly as today.
Whatever residual remains for hand-written records (provenance) is stated in the close-guard docs, not left implied.
